freezeNote: No page on any site is edited until 1 Dec 2026, so Google can index what is new and every change can be read cleanly. Only the scheduled blog posters publish.

changes.title: AdSense readiness pass on every site
changes.detail: About, Contact, Privacy and Terms pages on every site; the empty ad boxes on the tool sites removed; thin or near-identical pages merged or set to noindex; invented numbers taken off streamerosai.com.
changes.expect: Fewer thin pages kept in Google and better quality signals for the whole domain. Read it by pages in Google and impressions per day.

changes.title: Math: deepened the date and average calculators
changes.detail: The two thinnest tool pages gained real explanation and worked examples. The percentage guides were lengthened.
changes.expect: Pages stay in Google and gain impressions.

changes.title: Calc: six near-identical pages set to noindex
changes.detail: Templated minor currency pairs and a duplicate of a math page were taken out of Google on purpose.
changes.expect: The pages that remain are indexed more easily.

changes.title: streamerosai.com: merged thin pages
changes.detail: Three thin emote pages became one stronger page, one post was folded into a better one, and the glossary index was set to noindex, with redirects for the old addresses.
changes.expect: Fewer weak pages and clearer signals for the strong ones.

changes.title: Esports: ten guides published at once
changes.detail: Ten tournament guides went live together, with Bing notified. Twenty more are queued from 18 Nov.
changes.expect: The ten guides get indexed within a few weeks and start to show for tournament searches.

changes.title: Scene switcher guide: new search-result description
changes.detail: The description now says it is a free OBS plugin for Windows, macOS and Linux. One optimizer experiment, judged on its own after 28 days.
changes.expect: More people click the result for the query advanced scene switcher (position 8.4, 20 impressions before).
